ood_source.caveat: Synthetic proxies (uniform noise, flat colour fields, tile-shuffled leaves, heavily degraded leaves) are genuinely out of distribution but are easier to reject than real photographs of unrelated subjects. The detection rates below are therefore an upper bound. Re-run with --ood-dir pointing at a real non-leaf corpus for a tighter estimate.

pipeline.interpretation: The deployed pipeline runs the image-quality gate before the model, so the end-to-end rejection rate is what a user experiences. The 'quality_gate_rejects_real_leaves' figure is the cost of that gate: the fraction of genuine test photographs it would ask the user to retake.

note: The serving path enforces the MSP and entropy thresholds. The energy threshold is recorded for reference; it is the least stable of the three across retraining because it depends on the absolute logit scale.

operating_point.reason: Chosen on 1,761 real validation photographs (PlantDoc, PlantWild, Plant Pathology 2021, CCMT, potato field; never the PlantDoc test split) by scripts/choose_real_operating_point.py: the most permissive threshold at which answers shown as a diagnosis are right at least 90% of the time. Shows 75.8% of real photos as a diagnosis (90.3% right); confidently wrong answers fall from 20.3% at the old 0.15 setting to 7.3%. Below it the app says it is unsure and shows the closest matches.
operating_point.note: `selected` holds the operating point in force. The values calibrated to keep 95% of laboratory leaves are stricter and are recorded here.
